program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = time; const tossedHeight = Math.max(0, launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2); const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; const isReleased = t >= apexTime; const dropTime = isReleased ? t - apexTime : 0; const dropHeight = isReleased ? Math.max(0, apexHeight - (gravity * dropTime * dropTime) / 2) : apexHeight; const dropVelocity = isReleased ? -gravity * dropTime : 0; const dropAcceleration = isReleased ? -gravity : 0; const heightScale = 140 / 2.2; const baseY = 360; const tossX = 180; const dropX = 460; const tossBallY = baseY - tossedHeight * heightScale; const dropBallY = baseY - dropHeight * heightScale; const apexY = baseY - apexHeight * heightScale; const gateOpen = isReleased; let tossState = "At launch"; if (t > 0 && t < apexTime) tossState = "Rising"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.02) tossState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime) tossState = "Falling"; if (t <= 0) tossState = "At launch"; if (t > apexTime && tossedHeight <= 0.05) tossState = "At launch height"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (isReleased && dropTime < 0.05) dropState = "Just released"; else if (isReleased && dropTime >= 0.05 && dropHeight > 0.05) dropState = "Falling together"; else if (isReleased && dropHeight <= 0.05) dropState = "At launch height"; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 50, y: 60, w: 260, h: 340, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 330, y: 60, w: 260, h: 340, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX, tossBallY, 26, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX, dropBallY, 26, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX - 20, y: tossBallY }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 20, y: tossBallY }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 6, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX - 20, y: dropBallY }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 20, y: dropBallY }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 6, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(tossX + 45, tossBallY - 20, [`v: ${sdk.format(tossedVelocity, 2)} m/s`, `a: ${sdk.format(tossedAcceleration, 2)} m/s²`], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(dropX + 45, dropBallY - 20, [`v: ${sdk.format(dropVelocity, 2)} m/s`, `a: ${sdk.format(dropAcceleration, 2)} m/s²`], { id: "callout.drop" })); objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate", dropX, apexY, { open: gateOpen, w: 44, label: "Gate" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, apexTime, apexHeight, tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps pulling with acceleration -g. A released second ball falls alongside the toss from that moment.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a second ball held by a gate at the apex. Both balls display velocity and acceleration vectors and readouts as time advances.
assumptions: No air resistance, constant gravity, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play or use the scrubber to inspect motion around the top.
